verdict.rationale: Basecamp ships its own progress-reporting views. Hill Charts show where work stands, and Everything Views pull items of one type from all projects onto a single page. There is no evidence that a product manager can build custom dashboards or configure widgets. missing for 10: user-configurable dashboard builder, customizable reporting widgets, progress metrics or aggregate reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress

citations.quote: Basecamp’s Hill Charts let you know exactly where things really stand.
Everything Views pull everything of one type onto a single page, no matter which project it’s in.
